scenario: [LNLS.3.3] — "every positive pattern after the first is anchored to an earlier one", where the earlier one need not be the first. Three `logical` schemas keyed alike; the third pattern anchors to the SECOND, not the first. PATH PINNED: `dsc.validate.anchor_body` accumulates every judged `logical` pattern as a candidate anchor; checking only against the first pattern would raise DS_VALIDATE_NOLINSCAN_JOIN_ANCHOR_C on `z`.
rules_ds:
use default:
    linear_scan: false

schema Device scope logical:
    device_id: String key

schema Reading scope logical:
    device_id: String key
    amount: Int mutable

schema Limit scope logical:
    device_id: String key
    ceiling: Int mutable

rule joined:
    Device d
    Reading x where x.device_id == d.device_id
    Limit z where z.device_id == x.device_id
->
    log info "x"
